name: australian-estate-planning
description: Generate solicitor-reviewable sidecar profiles from uploaded human-designed NSW and Victorian estate precedents, then assemble documents from provenance-cited instructions using only confirmed sites in working copies. The source precedents remain unchanged, every reuse checks for anchor drift, and no document is drafted from scratch.

interface.shortDescription: Profiles uploaded NSW and Victorian estate precedents, then fills confirmed sites safely. Source precedents remain unchanged.
interface.longDescription: Creates proposed sidecar profiles from uploaded clean, human-designed firm estate precedents without modifying or filling them. The dedicated onboarding workflow records source identity and fingerprint, exact factual and clause sites, schema coverage, field maps and closed verbatim clause registers, then stops for responsible-solicitor confirmation. The two jurisdictional assembly workflows separately extract provenance-cited instructions and fill working copies only after the confirmed profile's fingerprint, structural locations, exact anchors and expected occurrence counts still match; any drift makes that document NOT READY. The plugin covers wills and enduring powers of attorney in New South Wales and Victoria, NSW appointments of enduring guardian, and Victorian appointments of medical treatment decision maker. Executed or client-completed files are rejected, no precedent or confirmed profile means no draft, and the workflows never compose a document from scratch.
defaultPrompt: Extract an instruction record from this completed estate planning instruction sheet.
Present the extraction table with provenance for my confirmation before drafting anything.
Register this human-designed precedent in a sidecar profile without modifying the source document.
Generate separate proposed precedent profiles from these uploaded NSW and Victorian firm precedents.
Fill the firm's NSW will precedent from the confirmed instruction record.
Fill the enduring power of attorney and appointment of enduring guardian precedents for the same client.
Fill the firm's Victorian will, enduring power of attorney and medical treatment decision-maker appointment precedents.
Show me the change manifest and gap report for the last fill.
List the execution requirements for each document and where each one comes from.
